selection_reason: CSW-01 completed_verified in PR #413. The owner-approved interleave selects CSW-02 immediately after CSW-01 before returning to APW-02.
objective: Define the Creative Library, Story Bible and long-term Project Memory model so creators can find, understand, relate, version, recover and reuse Creative Fragments and governed references across projects without collapsing pre-authoritative material into target-domain truth or leaking protected information.
completion_gate: A creator can reliably answer what they made, where it is, how it changed, what uses or derives from it, what related material exists and what remains unfinished, with visibility-safe search/graph/history/recovery and without treating Story Bible projections as an alternate authoritative domain.
required_design_questions: What is a Creative Library versus a Story Bible versus a project/collection view?
Which project/folder/tag/collection relationships are organizational projections rather than ownership or truth?
How are used-in, derived-from, inspired-by, branch, superseded, incorporated and backlinks projected from CSW-01 stable IDs/receipts?
How are governed World/Adventure/Character/Campaign/A9 objects referenced without duplicating their truth into Story Bible persistence?
How are timeline/history and change provenance represented over long projects?
How do search, filters, saved views, graph and outline views filter authorization before counts/topology/similarity?
How are duplicates and near-duplicates suggested without silent merge?
How are archive, tombstone, rediscovery, import/export and recovery handled?
How can a creator see unresolved/open/unused material while distinguishing pre-authoritative fragments from authoritative facts?
next_action: Execute CSW-02 as a bounded design/governance tranche using CSW-01 stable Creative Fragment identity/relationships/incorporation receipts and existing A10/APW authority as dependencies.
